cases.question: Tell me about Pdfroo
cases.judge_reason: All claims match the expected facts and known public details about Pdfroo.
cases.answer:
**Pdfroo** is Ayush's fully client-side PDF editor — open a PDF in your browser, annotate, sign, rearrange/merge pages, compress, find & replace, and download a real flattened PDF. Nothing ever leaves your device; all parsing, rendering, and writing happen locally via **pdf.js + pdf-lib**, and it works offline once loaded.

**Highlights**
- **Zero backend, zero build step** — just open `index.html` or hit the live demo
- **Responsive**: phone (375 px), tablet (768 px), desktop (1440 px+) with mouse, pen, or touch
- **Pages panel**: thumbnail sidebar (desktop), slide-in drawer (tablet), bottom sheet (phone); drag-to-reorder via SortableJS, rotate, duplicate, delete, insert blank, merge multiple PDFs
- **Landing page** with kangaroo mascot, built-in sample PDF, shortcuts to Find & Replace and Compress, Indian-language section, and a "pouch promise" privacy note
- **Tiny delight**: after first successful download, a kangaroo toast says *"Done! Your PDF never left your device. Go enjoy a coffee ☕"* — no donation ask, auto-dismisses

**Tech**: JavaScript, CSS, HTML (pdf.js, pdf-lib, SortableJS, local Fredoka/Nunito/Baloo 2 fonts, SVG mascot)  
**Repo**: [ayush4u/pdfroo](https://github.c
